title: Report: Citi Bank Predicts New Red Dead Game Could Launch by 2027-2028
description: Investment bank Citi says a new Red Dead title could arrive in 2027 or 2028, but Rockstar's development cycle may make that timeline unrealistic.
youtubeTitle: Red Dead 2027? Citi Bank Predicts New Rockstar Game
socialHook: Citi bank says a new Red Dead game could launch by 2027 or 2028.

sections.heading: Citi's Prediction
paragraphs: GameSpot reports that investment bank Citi, in a note cited by Yahoo Finance, suggested that a new Red Dead game could launch as early as 2027 or 2028, a timeline that would be unprecedented for Rockstar.

sections.heading: Development Timeline
paragraphs: The same article notes that Rockstar historically spaces major releases several years apart, with Red Dead Redemption in 2010, Grand Theft Auto V in 2013, Red Dead Redemption II in 2018, and Grand Theft Auto VI expected in 2026, making a 2027 launch a significant acceleration.

sections.heading: Industry Context
paragraphs: Take‑Two CEO Strauss Zelnick recently told The Game Business that recent technological advances could compress development timelines without sacrificing quality, while Rockstar's Phil Hooker noted that hiring sprees and technology updates may also speed up production.

sources.title: Next Red Dead Launching By 2027 Or 2028 “May Not Be Unreasonable,” Bank Says, But It Definitely Is
